title: Effectivity reflected by refinement of singleton fpqc coverings
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ and $g:X\prime\to S$ be singleton fpqc coverings [def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering] of schemes [def-pc-scheme], and let $h:X\prime\to X$ satisfy $g=f\circ h$. Let $D$ on $V\to X$ and $E$ on $V\prime\to X\prime$ be descent data [def-pd-descent-datum]. Suppose $q:V\prime\to V$ gives a pullback square [def-pc-fibre-product] over $h$ and intertwines their transports (IsBaseChange). If $E$ is effective, then $D$ is effective.

source.place: Tag 02W3, lemma-descending-types-morphisms, affine-base proof: effectivity after refinement; Tag 02W0

proof.text: An effective object W over S for E gives a canonical datum on W times_S X. Its pullback along h is identified with E by the effective square and pullback associativity. The canonical transport fixes the W-coordinate.

source.place: Tag 02W3, lemma-descending-types-morphisms, affine-base proof: effectivity after refinement; Tag 02W0

proof.text: Fullness of refinement descends the identification and its inverse to compatible maps between the canonical datum and D. Faithfulness makes the composites identities. The resulting isomorphism gives an invariant projection V to W, witnessing effectivity.

theorem fpqc_refinement_reflects_effectivity {S X X' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (g : X' ⟶ S) (h : X' ⟶ X)
    (hf : Presieve.singleton f ∈ Scheme.fpqcPrecoverage S)
    (hg : Presieve.singleton g ∈ Scheme.fpqcPrecoverage S) (hc : h ≫ f = g)
    {V : Over X} {V' : Over X'} (q : V'.left ⟶ V.left)
    (hq : q ≫ V.hom = V'.hom ≫ h)
    (D : Over.DescentDatum f V) (E : Over.DescentDatum g V')
    (hp : IsPullback q V'.hom V.hom h)
    (hD : Over.DescentDatum.IsBaseChange hc hq D E) (hE : E.IsEffective) :
    D.IsEffective
